name: OpenID Connect
tagline: OpenID Connect is an identity module on top of the OAuth 2.0

git.lastCommit: 3f0209b 2026-07-15 ci: Auto update Github Action workflows

readme.overview: The OpenID Connect module is an identity module on top of the OAuth 2.0 protocol, allowing clients to verify the identity of end-users based on the authentication performed by an authorization server. It also provides basic user profile information.
keyFeatures: Authentication: Ensures secure user authentication and authorization.
Single Sign-On (SSO): Allows users to log in once and gain access to multiple applications.
User Information: Provides access to user profile information.
Interoperability: Works with various identity providers like Google, Microsoft, and others.
Security: Implements robust security measures to protect user data.

notes.forAnalyst: Signing in through any standards-compliant OpenID Connect provider.
notes.forArchitect: The generic identity adapter — no dependencies, no storage — and the answer when a customer brings their own identity provider rather than one of the named ones.
notes.forDeveloper: Everything is in the provider's discovery document and your claim mapping. Prefer this over a provider-specific module when the requirement is 'their IdP'.
reachForItWhen: Users must sign in with an identity your organisation already owns
You need to stop managing passwords in the platform
A B2B customer requires their own directory
doNotReachForItWhen: Authorisation questions — this only proves who someone is
Storefront customer accounts, unless the business really wants a corporate directory for shoppers
You expect roles to arrive automatically: mapping is configuration you must do
